title: Privacy Policy - How ToolsBuilt Protects Your Data
description: Read the privacy policy for ToolsBuilt. Learn how we handle cookies, Google AdSense third-party advertising, and local data storage.
subtitle: Last updated: October 11, 2026

tool.p1: At ToolsBuilt (accessible from https://toolsbuilt.com), one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document details the types of information collected and recorded by ToolsBuilt and how we use it.

client-side-tool-processing.heading: Client-Side Tool Processing
client-side-tool-processing.p1: ToolsBuilt is designed as a client-side utility suite. When you enter dates, numbers, or parameters into our calculators (such as the Days Until Date Calculator), all computations take place locally within your web browser. We do not transmit, collect, store, or share your calculator inputs on any server.

log-files.heading: Log Files
log-files.p1: ToolsBuilt follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. Web hosting companies log standard data such as internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and number of clicks. This information is not linked to any personally identifiable information and is used exclusively for analyzing web performance, administering the site, and securing infrastructure.

cookies-consent-local-storage.heading: Cookies, Consent & Local Storage
cookies-consent-local-storage.p1: ToolsBuilt uses minimal local browser storage and strictly privacy-focused consent controls. We use local storage on your device to remember preferences such as your theme (Light or Dark mode), your cookie consent choices, and the tools you recently visited. This data is never sent to our servers. Sensitive inputs, including passwords generated by the Password Generator and names in the Random Name Picker, are never stored.
cookies-consent-local-storage.p2: When you first visit ToolsBuilt, an explicit cookie consent banner asks whether you accept analytics cookies. Google Analytics is completely blocked and will not load until you explicitly grant consent. You can modify your choices at any time using the Cookie Settings link in the footer.

analytics.heading: Analytics
analytics.p1: We use Google Analytics (measurement ID G-QR15X9WS1J) solely to understand aggregated traffic trends (such as page views, general device categories, and approximate geography). Google Analytics is only loaded after you click "Accept" on our cookie banner. Furthermore, if your browser has Do Not Track enabled (DNT: 1), Google Analytics is never loaded regardless of banner status. You can also opt out globally via the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on.

your-tool-inputs.heading: Your Tool Inputs
your-tool-inputs.p1: Values you enter into our calculators and tools are processed in your browser and are not sent to our servers.

google-adsense-third-party-advertising.heading: Google AdSense & Third-Party Advertising
google-adsense-third-party-advertising.p1: We may display third-party advertisements served by Google AdSense and its partner advertising networks on ToolsBuilt to support our free operations.
google-adsense-third-party-advertising.li1: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to ToolsBuilt or other websites on the internet.
google-adsense-third-party-advertising.li2: Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visit to ToolsBuilt and/or other sites on the Internet.
google-adsense-third-party-advertising.li3: Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. Alternatively, you can opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting www.aboutads.info.

third-party-privacy-policies.heading: Third Party Privacy Policies
third-party-privacy-policies.p1: ToolsBuilt's Privacy Policy does not apply to other advertisers or third-party websites. Thus, we advise you to consult the respective Privacy Policies of these third-party ad servers for more detailed information. It may include their practices and instructions about how to opt-out of certain options.
third-party-privacy-policies.p2: You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser options. Detailed information about cookie management with specific web browsers can be found at the browsers' respective websites.

ccpa-privacy-rights-do-not-sell.heading: CCPA Privacy Rights (Do Not Sell My Personal Information)
ccpa-privacy-rights-do-not-sell.p1: Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), California consumers have the right to:
ccpa-privacy-rights-do-not-sell.li1: Request that a business that collects a consumer's personal data disclose the categories and specific pieces of personal data collected.
ccpa-privacy-rights-do-not-sell.li2: Request that a business delete any personal data about the consumer that a business has collected.
ccpa-privacy-rights-do-not-sell.li3: Request that a business that sells a consumer's personal data, not sell the consumer's personal data.
ccpa-privacy-rights-do-not-sell.p2: ToolsBuilt does not sell personal data. If you make a request regarding your rights, we have one month to respond to you. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us at abuumair2025@gmail.com.

gdpr-data-protection-rights.heading: GDPR Data Protection Rights
gdpr-data-protection-rights.p1: We want to ensure you are fully aware of all of your data protection rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Every user is entitled to the following:
gdpr-data-protection-rights.li1: The right to access: You have the right to request copies of your personal data.
gdpr-data-protection-rights.li2: The right to rectification: You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate.
gdpr-data-protection-rights.li3: The right to erasure: You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.

children-s-information.heading: Children's Information
children-s-information.p1: Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity. ToolsBuilt does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13.

consent.heading: Consent
consent.p1: By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.
